course_id: Tiếng Anh - Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 1
title: English - Reading and Writing Skills 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to understand texts at B1 and B1+ levels according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
Students will learn techniques to build their vocabulary effectively.
Students will develop the ability to write academic paragraphs including introductions, main ideas, supporting details, and conclusions.
